summary: Two-piece landscape adhesive card holder, lanyard left, with black 1.5 mm raised XonarLabs logo and lettering on front lid.

required_interfaces.description: Retain 100 x 65 x 1 mm card in a 100.6 x 65.6 x 1.4 mm top-open cavity.
Front lid with square top corners nests into 1.6 mm deep base seat, 0.07 mm per-side clearance; U-shaped adhesive ledge is flat with no glue reservoir.
Horizontal capsule through base top extension; 5 mm height retained, width widened to 18 mm by estimate from user image 4.
18 x 32 mm capsule through-slot in bottom cover; vertically centered on complete bottom-cover outline.

XonarLabs lettering directly traced from font_image_new, preserving original glyph shapes, stroke proportions, holes and relative spacing, uniformly scaled; black relief1.5 mm high. Existing three sharp-edged bars retain0.3 mm-wide,0.6 mm-deep rear-only grooves, foreground intact. Total artwork width88 mm; lanyard left. Relief and front lid base must be boolean-unioned into one valid solid.

external_references.description: Original brand photograph for logo and overall layout; lettering is superseded by font_image_new.
Close-up showing the three overlapping sharp-corner black logo blocks.
Sole lettering reference: user supplied clean black-on-white XonarLabs wordmark. Trace shapes and spacing directly.

assembly_story.installation: Print bottom cover and unified front cover separately. Front cover is one solid including the 1.5 mm raised artwork; apply black finish to raised letters and logo. Dry-fit and adhesive-bond front cover into base. Lanyard points left in reading orientation.
assembly_story.maintenance: Insert/remove card at lanyard end (left when artwork is horizontal); push via centered rear thumb slot. Adhesive joint is permanent.

designs.description: Two printable halves in assembled position.
